subject: Trade Brigade Newsletter Scans 💰 12/02/24

self_score.opener:
Markets rang in new all time highs last Friday on the shortened holiday session.

This marks the 53rd all time high this year. Not to mention we are coming into what looks like it could be another year of +20% gains.

Currently the S&P is up 27% headed into December.

So is December going to ruin it

swing_ideas.text: Ascending triangle on the daily. Breaking out of a multi month base. Ideally this can get in gear over 23.25 to see ~32 over time.
Daily bull flag in place with a possible breakout area over the 73.1 mark. Thin structure to retrace back towards the 80.20 area.

Market internals – Notice on the big fade from Monday, the market internals really were not bearish. Although the gap closed and it seemed like sellers were making a stand, it wasn't all that bad. Friday's rally shows a great spread of internals even on a half day to support the rally.

Market profile – Value moved higher on the Friday move validating the buyers there. Key is to hold over the VAL otherwise it will be easier for traders to liquidate who have poor location. This 6040 area is the same as SPY 600.5.
